name: Dal Lightspark
backstory: Harper Lightspark is a dead gold dwarven Harper whose corpse is in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at , close to He Who Was. He, and two other Harpers, went on an expedition to scout the boundaries of the Shadow Curse, before eventually getting lost and succumbing to it before they could make it back to the Last Light Inn.
